events.title: Oasis' 'Definitely Maybe' turns 32
events.blurb: Oasis released their iconic debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Anniversary
angles.copy: 32 years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe'! What's your standout track from this Britpop masterpiece?

events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place from August 15 to 18, 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Remembered
angles.copy: Peace, love, and three days of music! Remembering the iconic Woodstock Festival, which kicked off on this day in '69.

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Elvis Presley passed away on August 16, 1977.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering The King, Elvis Presley, on the anniversary of his passing. His music lives on.

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Tupac Shakur passed away on September 13, 1996, at the age of 25, six days after being shot in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac Tribute
angles.copy: 2Pac would have been 55. Remembering the powerful legacy of Tupac Shakur, who left us on this day in '96. His words still resonate.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Jimi Hendrix passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled guitar genius, Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84 today. His sound changed everything.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: It's 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That cover, those songs... pure genius. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! A true rock icon.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, former Oasis frontman, was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still rocking the world.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album turns 55
events.blurb: John Lennon released his seminal album 'Imagine' in the UK on October 8, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon's 'Imagine' album arrived. A timeless message for peace.

events.title: The iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first iPod on October 23, 2001, promising '1,000 songs in your pocket'.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember when the iPod changed how we listened to music? It's 25 years since Apple unveiled this game-changer!

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred! Happy James Bond Day to all the 007 fans out there. What's your favourite Bond film or theme song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: John Lennon Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: John Cleese, legendary comedian and actor, was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the utterly brilliant John Cleese! What's your favourite Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released 'The Beatles' (commonly known as the 'White Album') on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: It's 58 years since The Beatles' iconic 'White Album' dropped! A double album of incredible diversity. What's your go-to track?
